To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the physics reach at the LHC can be extended with an order of magnitude increase in luminosity, but the SLHC will require significant upgrades in the detector systems.

• the SLHC will be a very powerful tool for the exploration of new physics; • the SLHC physics potential is limited by the increased number of pileup events; • the pileup events are mostly due to inelastic proton-proton interactions; • inelastic events are characterized by the presence of many soft hadrons; • the inelastic events can be modeled by a simple parameterization; • the parameterization can be used to estimate the impact of the increased pileup on jet reconstruction and
the physics reach at the SLHC is significantly enhanced over that of the LHC.

the physics reach of the SLHC, the associated detector upgrades, and the physics and detector implications of the increased pileup.

the physics reach and detector needs for the SLHC.
